PROFILE SUMMARY
Control Management professional with 12+ years of experience in Business Analysis and Business Control Management across Commercial Banking (CB), Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), Risk & Regulatory and Consumer and Small Business Banking.
Expertise in operational risk, control assurance, audit readiness, and governance enhancement within first-line risk frameworks.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Wells Fargo | Jan 2020 – Aug 2025 Senior Control Management Specialist – AVP Teams: CB & CIB Business Control Management / Global Delivery Control Assurance / Central Control Programs / Operational Risk Events QA Key Responsibilities
Worked closely with business stakeholders to gather and document control
requirements, assess process impacts, and support the implementation of risk and control enhancement initiatives across Commercial Banking and CIB.
CAREER PROGRESSION
Partnered with Technology, QA, and Operations teams during control automation
and process improvement initiatives, coordinating UAT, validating business requirements, and ensuring successful production implementation.
Jan 2020 – Aug 2025 Wells Fargo Sr. Control Mgmt Specialist – AVP
Maintained project governance trackers, coordinated project milestones and stakeholder meetings, monitored action items and risks, and provided regular executive status updates and governance reporting to senior leadership.
Jun 2013 – Jan 2020 Northern Trust Associate Consultant (Operations Control)
End-to-end process reviews to identify, assess, and mitigate risk within set thresholds. • Supported IRM in conducting business audits and regulatory reviews. • Advised business units during Global RCSA workshops and EUCT initiatives. • Provided consultative support for incident management (ORE, Non-ORE, DLP, compromised data).
Coordinated Shared Control Agreements and quarterly control reporting for business units.
Acted as a liaison during IP transition and migration projects, ensuring robust control alignment.
Created executive-level presentations for senior leadership (Council & MBR meetings). • Trained new hires on control frameworks and best practices. • Facilitated awareness sessions on trending risk topics (e.g., social engineering, incident handling).
Supported FMEA documentation, ERIA questionnaires, and cross-training frameworks. • Partnered with Central Control to prepare IP control reports and BCM data governance input.
Northern Trust | Jun 2013 – Jan 2020 Associate Consultant – Operations Control Progressed: Senior Analyst → Technical Coordinator → Associate Consultant
Team: Income and International Tax Group (CIB – Securities Operations)
Key Responsibilities
Led E2E control testing with the middle office ensuring consistency in governance and compliance.
Produced BOD/EOD regulatory reports for requirements including CASS and Escheatment.
Approved profit and loss statements for Custody teams and supported internal audits (SOC/GS007).
Enhanced business documentation consistency and EUC governance. • Supported Business Continuity Simulations and FMEA creation. • Managed onboarding and transition for AUD accounts by establishing SOPs and control standards.
Successfully led Securities Services APAC client migrations to Manila, including training, documentation, and post-migration stabilization.
Risk Management: Led risk mitigation strategies by conducting control checks and quality analysis, ensuring compliance while managing complex issues.
Team Leadership: Spearheaded a high-performing team, utilizing strong project management skills to allocate resources effectively, track progress with dashboards, and provide technical support that boosted team productivity.
Problem Solving: Solved intricate escalated issues with a focus on advanced problem- solving techniques, earning recognition from clients & senior management for exceptional results.
Data Analysis: Drove performance through the preparation and analysis of KPIs and KRIs, consistently delivering insightful reports for strategic decision-making.
Change Management: Implemented robust change management strategies, leading to seamless operations and continuous improvement in service delivery.
Process Migration: Played a pivotal role in process migration across regions, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruption.
Reconciliation & Settlements: Managed the timely reconciliation and settlement of client entitlements, enhancing overall operational efficiency.
Data Integrity: Led efforts in identifying and addressing data inconsistencies, collaborating with upstream partners and consultants to close gaps and improve system performance.
Process Optimization: Championed the development and execution of new processes and procedures, resulting in streamlined workflow and measurable productivity gains.
Stakeholder Communication: Drove successful change management initiatives, effectively communicating technology upgrades and process improvements to stakeholders.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Managed cross-functional technical teams, ensuring optimal performance and timely project completion.
